title_en: US loses measles-elimination status after 26 years, WSJ reports
summary_en: The Pan American Health Organization has reportedly stripped the US of its measles-elimination status after 26 years, as the country battles its worst outbreaks in more than three decades.

title_en: Microsoft says all services working again
summary_en: US tech giant Microsoft says it has fixed problems that led to a global outage of its services. The glitch severely disrupted online communications in businesses and governments for more than 24 hours.

title_en: Sudan: Misery worsens amid plummeting aid for displaced people
summary_en: Sudan's humanitarian crisis is exacerbated by cuts in international aid. Almost 34 million people are in need as war and drone strikes are making it difficult to deliver aid to the population.

title_en: Nigeria: How the pcoming elections are influeced by the rise of AI disinformation
summary_en: As Nigeria inches closer to the 2027 polls, the use of artificial intelligence in the electoral process has prompted questions about integrity and institutional readiness. Can Nigerians trust their democratic processes?
